s: Nokri sheasa melaka bead yisrael ubo k"b seipim: muttar lezammen nokri lebeto leekol immo beshabbat, ap al pi sheasur beyom tob mishshum gezera shemma yarbeh lebashshel bishbilo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqy"b, abal beshabbat en lachush lazeh. Umuttar apillu litten mezonot lipne nokri bilbaddo, veap al pi sheen mezonotayv aleka, mikkol maqom, kevan shemmeparnesim aniyye nokrim mippene darke shalom — chashub kimzonotayv aleka:

Umuttar litten lepanayv mezonot bechatzer, ap al pi sheyyodea sheyyotzien lachutz. Vehu sheyyihyeh lo reshut leoklan sham im yirtzeh. Umikkol maqom, lo yitten hu leyado mammash, kede shello yaaseh hu haaqira mereshut hayyachid, ella hannokri yittol miyyado, sheaz hannokri hu haoseh haaqira. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar im manniach al gabbe qarqa o al gabbe shulchan vehannokri notel mishsham. Abal im en hareshut beyado leoklan sham, o shehem mezonot merubbim shei epshar lo leoklan sham venikkar haddabar sheyyotzien lachutz, veken im hannokri omed bachutz upashat yado lipnim sheyyadua venikkar hu sheyyotzi — asur litten lepanayv, mippene shennireh kenoten lo al menat lehotzi. Veap shemmotzi lahanaato velo bishbil yisrael, mikkol maqom, kevan sheddabar zeh shehu motzi noteno lo hayyisrael mishshello — asur mittaam shennitbaer besiman sh"z:

Vaapillu kesheomed bipnim, lo hittiru litten lepanayv ella mezonot, sheyyittaken leoklam bechatzer, abal lo shear chapatzim shedderek lehotzian, mippene shennireh kenoten lo al menat lehotzi. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bachapatzim shel yisrael. Abal chapatzim shel nokri muttar littenam lo, sheap shennireh kenoten lo al menat lehotzi — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno motzi bishbil hayyisrael ella bishbil atzmo, vehachepetz eno shel yisrael. Vaapillu lomar beperush: "aseh melakteka bachapatzim shelleka" — muttar, kemo shennitbaer sham. Umikkol maqom, im hannokri omed bachutz upashat yado lipnim — asur litten lepanayv apillu chapatzim shello, mippene marit haayin, sheharoeh sheyyisrael noten lo sabur shehu chepetz shel yisrael, mah sheen ken keshennoten lepanayv bechatzer, sheen sham roim, veharoeh oto yotze mereshut yisrael vechepetz beyado hu sabur shemmotzi chepetz shello velo shel hayyisrael. (Umikkol maqom, im haemet hu shehu chepetz shel yisrael — asur, shemma yivvada haemet leharoim veyachsheduhu shennetano lo kede lehotzio bishbilo, mah sheen ken bechepetz shel nokri, im yivvada hoomet laroim en kan chashad kelal):

Vaapillu hu chepetz shel nokri ella shehu memushkan leyisrael — dino kechepetz shel yisrael, apillu pedao hannokri (ken mashma besiman rn"b gabbe mekira) mibbeod yom. Vaapillu im yiched maqom lehannokri mibbeod yom betok reshuto lehanniach sham mashkono ad lemachar sheyyabo veyittelennu mishsham — asur lehannicho littelo beshabbat, mishshum marit haayin. Ella im ken shehannokri hu allam, sheaz yesh lehaqel apillu lo yiched lo maqom. Veken bemaqom sheyyesh bo mishshum darke shalom, kegon nokri shechala veshalach achar maakal yisrael — muttar latet lo o apillav lishloach lo al yede nokri. Vehu haddin letzorek mitzva, kegon lehotzi chametz mibbeto bappesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"d, mippene shehashshelichut al yede nokri hu shebut, veakshav sheyyesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim ella karmelit, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shm"h, hu shebut dishbut, vehittiruhu letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"z. Vehu haddin mippene darke shalavam, vehu haddin benokri allam. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello yitten leyad hannokri mammash, kevan sheepshar belo zeh. Vaapillu bachapatzim shel nokri tzarik lizzaher bazeh:

Muttar lehachalip mashkon lenokri beshabbat im hu malbush veyotziennu hannokri derek malbush, ki en zeh massa umattan. Vegam beyisrael muttar beinyan zeh, im hayyisrael tzarik lelobsho beshabbat. Veim hannokri mebi hammaot venotel hammashkon — muttar gam ken, ubilbad shello yachshob immo. Vetob shehannokri yiqqach hammashkon beatzmo velo yigga bo hayyisrael, kede shello yehe nireh kenose venoten. Veim hebi lo mashkon acher — lo yigga gam bo:

Bimqomot shennohagim leekol pat shel palter nokri — yesh mattirin liqqach mimmennu beshabbat apillu pat shenneepet hayyom, im hi ir sherubbah nokrim, sheaz min hassetam hi neepet bishbil hannokrim velo bishbil hayyisrael, veim ken en leesor otah middin nokri haoseh melaka bishbil yisrael. Vegam en leesor otah middin muqtzeh, apillu im hayeta qemach o issa beben hashshemashot, shehen muqtzin, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"ch — en omerim bah "mittok shehuqtzet beben hashshemashot huqtzet lekol hashshabbat kullah", lepi sheen omerim ken ella bedabar shennittaqqen venaasa rauy meelayv mishshechasheka, kegon ner shekkaba meelayv mishshechasheka, abal kol dabar sheggemaro bide adam, dehaynu shennigmar tiqquno beshabbat venaasa rauy al yede adam — en bo mishshum muqtzeh kelal, apillu beben hashshemashot beodo eno rauy, mippene sheeno maqtzeh mimmennu dato kelal beben hashshemashot millehanot mimmennu beshabbat, kevan shebbeyado hu letaqqeno velaasoto rauy bo bayyom, kegon haqqemach shebbeyad nokri — en lo din muqtzeh kelal beshabbat, mippene shebbeyado hu leepoto velaasoto rauy bo bayyom, vekevan shehu mukan lehannokri bealayv — hare zeh mukan lakkol. Veyesh omerim shello ameru kol dabar sheggemaro bide adam en bo mishshum muqtzeh, ella bedabar shehatchalat meleket tiqquno kede laasoto rauy hayeta qodem hashshabbat venigmera beshabbat, kegon nokri shehitchil laasot keli meereb yom tob ugemaro beyom tob — en bo mishshum nolad, hoil ugemaro bide adam, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"b (veken pat shehitchil leepotah, dehaynu shennetanah battannur mibbeod yom, ap shebbeben hashshemashot lo hayeta reuya — adayin en bah mishshum muqtzeh). Abal pat shehatchalat meleket tiqqunah sheal yede kak naaset rauy, dehaynu meleket apiyyatah, hayeta beshabbat — yesh bah mishshum muqtzeh, im hayeta qemach o issa beben hashshemashot. Abal im hayeta tebua beben hashshemashot, venitchana veneepet beshabbat — en bah mishshum muqtzeh, velo mishshum nolad beyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqy"z. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kasbara haacharona. Ella im ken hu sheat haddechaq, kegon sheddar bikpar yechidi, shei epshar lo lishol pat mechabero, o letzorek mitzva, kegon seuddat berit mila, o letzorek birkat hammotzi — azay yesh lismok al hammattirim. Umikkol maqom, asur litten maot lehappalter meereb shabbat sheyyitten lo happat beshabbat, sheaz hu opeh letzorek yisrael, veasur leekol mehappat ad lemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, kemo sheyyitbaer:

(Vekol zeh bepat. Abal nokri shebbishshel leatzmo, middebarim sheen bahem mishshum bishshule nokrim — en bahem mishshum muqtzeh ledibre hakkol, apillu hen perot sheenan neekalim chayyin velo hayu reuyim kelal ben hashshemashot, lepi sheen omerim "mittok shehuqtza ben hashshemashot huqtza lekol hashshabbat kullah", ella bedabar shemmaqtzeh oto haadam middato udechao beyadayim, kegon tebua shettechanah vaasaah qemach, abal lo bedabar shehu muqtzeh beal korcho shel adam, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"y):

Vekol zeh baapiyya (ubishshul) vekayyotze bahen mishshear melakot hannaasot betalush, chutz missechitat perot, sheim sechatan nokri apillu leatzmo — asurim hammashqim leyisrael ad laereb, im hu beinyan shehayu asurim im hayu zabim mealehen, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"k, lepi sheggam ellu hammashqin habbaim leyisrael al yede sechitat nokri hem biklal haggezera sheggazeru al mashqin shezzabu mealehen, mippene sheggam ellu baim lehayyisrael mimmela kemo hazzabin mealehen. Veken nokri shelliqqet perot mehamchubbar leatzmo, apillu hu beinyan sheen bahem mishshum muqtzeh, kegon sheshshama et hannokri omer meereb shabbat "lemachar elqot perot ellu", vehen perot shennigmar bishshulan, shehakana moelet lahen apillu bimchubbar, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"ch — ap al pi ken asurim leyisrael ad laereb, lepi shehem biklal haggezera sheggazeru al perot hannosherim mealehen, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"b, sheggam perot ellu baim lehayyisrael mimmela kemo hannosherim mealehem. Velo perot bilbad, ella apillu kol mechubbar shennitlash meelayv o al yede nokri, ap al pi sheeno maakal adam, hu biklal gezera zo. Kegon nokri shelliqqet asabim mehamchubbar, apillu hu beinyan sheen bahem mishshum muqtzeh, kegon sheyyesh leyisrael behemot sheyyekolim lirot sham baasabim ellu vahare hem mukanim lo — ap al pi ken asurim mishshum gezerat perot hannosherim. Velaken asur leyisrael lehishtammesh bahem shum tashmish, kemo sheasur lehishtammesh beperot hannosherim. Velaken hem asurim gam ken betiltul, kevan sheenan reuyim lo bo bayyom lehishtammesh bahem shum tashmish, vahare hem muqtzim, kemo shepperot hannosherim yesh lahem din muqtzeh mittaam zeh. Vaapillu etzim shettelashan hannokri leatzmo o shennasheru mealehen beyom tob hem biklal gezera zo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"z. Veken nokri shetztzad dagim o chayya o op leatzmo — asurim leyisrael beyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqt"v:

Im liqqet o tzad o apa ubishshel o sheasa achat mishshear melakot bishbil yisrael, o bishbil yisrael venokrim — tzarik lehamtin laereb bikde sheyyeasu, gezera shemma yomar lannokri laasot beshabbat kede sheyyehe mukan lo bemotzae shabbat miyyad. Vaapillu acherim shello naaset hammelaka bishbilam tzerikim lehamtin ken, shekkol shennaaset meleket issur shel tora bishbil yisrael — hechemiru chakamim shello lechalleq ben mi shennaasa bishbilo laacherim. Abal im naasa issur shel dibre soperim bishbil yisrael — muttar laacherim miyyad, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veshiur "bikde sheyyeasu" — yitbaer besiman tqt"v:

Sapeq im liqqetan bishbil yisrael, o sheyyadua shelliqqetan bishbil yisrael veen yadua im nilqetu hayyom o lav — asurot bo bayyom vegam laereb bikde sheyyeasu. Veap al pi shehu sepeq dibre soperim — en holekin bo lehaqel, hoil vehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin". Veyesh omerim shellaereb muttar miyyad, shekkevan sheissur zeh eno ella keen qenas shello yabo lomar lannokri laasot lo beshabbat — lo hechemiru bispeqo, ap al pi sheyyesh lo mattirin. Vehaiqqar kasbara harishona. Veap lepi sebara haacharona — lo heqellu ella bikgon shehannokri amar leyisrael meereb shabbat litten lo perot beshabbat, vehalak lebet hannokri venatan lo, sheaz yesh lehistappeq shemma liqqet perot ellu beshabbat bishbil yisrael, vehaya bedato meereb shabbat al perot ellu lelaqqetam lo beshabbat, o shemma haya bedato lilqot lo perot acherim, uperot ellu liqqetam leatzmo o lenokri acher veachar kak nimlak unetanam leyisrael keshebba etzlo, veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Abal nokri shehebi doron leyisrael, o shehebi limkor beir sherubbah yisrael — en tolin lehaqel shemma liqqetan mittechilla leatzmo veachar kak nimlak lahabian lekan, ella min hassetam liqqetan mittechilla leshem kak. Veken en litlot lehaqel shemma liqqetan meereb shabbat, lepi shennokri hammebi doron o limkor — min hassetam hu mitkavven lehabi min hamshubbach, umebi meotan shelliqqet hayyom. Veken leinyan tzeda beyom tob:

Dabar sheen bo chashash tzeda umechubbar ella shehuba michutz lattechum, im hebio hannokri leatzmo o lenokri acher — muttar leyisrael apillu bo bayyom. Veim hebio leyisrael — asur baakila bo bayyom lemi shehuba bishbilo velaereb bikde sheyyeasu, gezera shemma yomar lannokri lehabi lo michutz lattechum beshabbat kede leekol mimmennu bo bayyom o laereb miyyad. Abal laacherim muttar apillu bo bayyom, lepi sheissur hattechumin hu middibre soperim, velo hechemiru kol kak beshel dibrehem leesor ap lemi shello huba bishbilo. Velaken ap mi shehuba bishbilo muttar lo letaltelo, ki en lo din muqtzeh, hoil vehu rauy laakila laacherim bo bayyom. Raq shetztzarik lizzaher shello letaltelo chutz learba ammot mimmaqom shehinnicho hannokri, im hinnicho bemaqom sheeno muqqap ledira, kegon besadeh o beir sheenah meorebet, dehaynu sheim tiltelo echad shette ammot — lo yetaltelennu hashsheni yoter mishte ammot, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"a bekol dabar shehotzio nokri chutz lattechum. Veim hubea bispina michutz lattechum — muttar baakila ap lemi shehuba bishbilo, im haleka hassepina lemala measara tepachim, sheen techumin lemala measara tepachim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"d. Raq shetztzarik lizzaher shello letaltelo chutz learba ammot, ella im ken haya bispina meereb shabbat, velo haya lematta measara tepachim mishshenniknas hashshabbat ad shehiggia letok hattechum shel maqom zeh shehu bo atta, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:

Ap al pi shehabba michutz lattechum muttar lemi shello huba bishbilo, mikkol maqom im hebiu shene debarim lishne bene adam — asurim lehachalip zeh im zeh, shehare al kol panim neheneh hu bemah shehuba lo michutz lattechum, sheal yede ken noten chabero lo et chalipayv:

Kol maqom shetztzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu — en tzarik lehamtin ella bikde sheshshaha hammebi beyom hashshabbat, kegon im hebi lo mimmaqom rachoq beshalosh shaot al hayyom beshabbat mippene shehu rakab al sus velaken miher habaato — eno tzarik lehamtin lemotzae shabbat kede halika lesham beregel, ella day sheyyamtin shalosh shaot. Veen tzarik lachush shemma lo rakab kol kak bimrutza ella rakab harbeh belel shabbat, ki min hassetam en derek lirkob ballayla. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyodea meezeh maqom hebi, abal im eno yodea kelal, veepshar shehebio mimmaqom qarob — day sheyyamtin lemotzae shabbat bikde habaa michutz lattechum, chutz mimmah shetztzarik lishhot bilqitato o tzedato im hu dabar sheyyesh bemino bimchubbar o mechussar tzeda, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqt"v. Veyesh omerim shebbekol maqom shetztzarik lehamtin bikde habaa michutz lattechum, veen tzarik lomar bemaqom shetztzarik lehamtin bikde habaa mimmaqom rachoq yoter — en lel motzae shabbat oleh min hacheshbon, vetzarik lehamtin shiur zeh lemachar beyom rishon. Lepi sheen regilut lehabi ballayla mimmaqom rachoq chutz lattechum, veim ken yesh lachush shemma mippene kak yomar lenokri lehabi lo beshabbat kede sheyyihyeh mukan lo belel motzae shabbat achar sheyyishheh shiur zeh. Veyesh lachush ledibrehem leinyan shabbat. Abal leinyan yom tob — yesh lehaqel kasbara harishona. Veap leinyan shabbat yesh lehaqel letzorek orechim o shear seuddat mitzva. Abal bemaqom shetztzarik lehamtin bikde habaa mittok hattechum, kegon nokri shelliqqet perot o tzad dagim betok hattechum, vetzarik lehamtin bikde leqita o tzeda vahabaa meoto maqom shelliqqet vetzad betok hattechum — hare hallayla oleh lo min hacheshbon ledibre hakkol:

Im hu sapeq im huba michutz lattechum — asur lemi shehuba bishbilo ad lemotzae shabbat bikde habaa michutz lattechum, mippene shehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin". Ulehaomerim shebbeissur kazeh, sheeno ella keen qenas shello yabo lomar lenokri laasot beshabbat, lo hechemiru bispeqo ap al pi sheyyesh lo mattirin, kemo shennitbaer lemala — ap kan muttar baakila apillu lemi shehuba bishbilo apillu bo bayyom. Ukebar nitbaer shehaiqqar kasbara harishona:

Vekol zeh benokri sheeno sharuy immo bair, abal nokri hashsharuy immo bair uperot hammetzuyim immo bair — en machaziqim missapeq lomar shemma hebian michutz lattechum, ki adderabba anu omerim "kan nimtzeu vekan hayu". Vaapillu im yesh lenokri shene battim, echad chutz lattechum veechad betok hattechum — tolin lehaqel shehebi mittok hattechum, ki min hassetam eno manniach bayit haqqarob veholek lehabi mibbayit harachoq. Abal im yesh lo shene battim chutz lattechum veechad betok hattechum — yesh lachush lerob habbattim shehem chutz lattechum:

Nokri shemmille mayim libhemto mibbor shehu amoq asara tepachim verachab arbaa tepachim haomed birshut harabbim, venimtza shehotzi mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim — muttar leyisrael lehashqot mehem behemto, kevan shehannokri lo nitkavven kelal bishbilo. Vehu sheen hannokri makkiro, abal im hu makkiro — asur, gezera shemma yarbeh hannokri lidlot gam bishbilo im yashqeh gam hu mehem. Vaapillu eno makkiro, im mille letzorek behemat yisrael — asur apillu laacherim lehishtammesh bemayim ellu apillu tashmish acher, kegon rechitza vahadachat kelim, shekkol shennaasa beissur shel tora al yede nokri letzorek yisrael — lo chillequ chakamim ben mi shennaasa bishbilo laacherim. Abal im mille mibbor haomed bekarmelit, o shehebi mayim lirshut harabbim min hannahar shehu karmelit — muttar leacher shello huba bishbilo, sheissur hakkarmelit eno ella middibre soperim. Veakshav nahagu haolam hetter apillu lekattechilla lomar lenokri lehabi shekar o shear debarim shehem tzorek hashshabbat derek karmelit. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut lomar shetztzorke shabbat chashubim hem kidbar mitzva, shehittiru bo shebut dishbut, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"z. Utzerikim hem lehizzaher shello litten hakkeli leyad hannokri, vegam shello liqqach miyyado, kemo shennitbaer sham, vegam shello litten maot lenokri, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqy"z. (Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel ella beshekar vekayyotze bo, mehaddebarim hatztzerikim beshabbat tzorek gamur, shei epshar lihyot biladam ella bedochaq qetzat. Abal debarim sheen tzarik kol kak, kegon perot umine tabshilim yeterim vekayyotze bahem — enan niqraim debar mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"a):

Liqqet nokri asabim mehamchubbar letzorek behemto — maakil acharayv yisrael et behemto, dehaynu sheomed bepaneha shello tukal lintot ella derek sham, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"d bekol dabar haasur betiltul, veap asabim ellu asurim betiltul, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vehu sheen hannokri makkiro, abal im makkiro — asur lo apillu laamod bepaneha kede shettokal mehem beshabbat, gezera shemma yarbeh hannokri lilqot bishbil behemto im yaakilenna mehem. Abal lemotzae shabbat en tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, kevan shehannokri liqqet letzorek atzmo, veen issuro beshabbat ella mishshum gezera shemma yarbeh bishbilo:

Veken haddin bekol dabar sheyyesh lachush bo shemma yarbeh bishbilo im hu makkiro, kegon nokri shetztzala o bishshel leatzmo debarim sheen bahem mishshum bishshule nokrim, vekol kayyotze bedabar zeh shetztzarik leharbot bo bishbil shenayim yoter mibbishbil echad. Abal bedabar sheen lachush bo shemma yarbeh bishbilo, kegon shehidliq ner leatzmo, o sheasa kebesh lered bo mehassepina, shebbener echad vekebesh echad yaspiq lakkol — apillu makkiro muttar:

Ap al pi sheeno makkiro, im omer beperush shelletzorek yisrael hu oseh, o apillu eno omer ken, im maasayv mokichim shelletzorek yisrael hu oseh, kegon shehidliq ner babbayit shehayyisrael bo vehalak lo hannokri velo nehena mimmennu kelum — asur lehishtammesh leoro:

Im liqqet nokri asabim (libhemto) veheekil (gam) lebehemat yisrael — en tzarik limchot beyado. Veap al pi shemmin hassetam liqqet gam letzorek yisrael — en issur beliqqut zeh kelal, ki kol nokri haoseh dabar meatzmo bevadday mitkavven hu letobat atzmo sheyyodea shello yapsid, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"b. Ubilbad shello yihyu asabim shel hayyisrael, ella shel hannokri o shel hepqer, mittaam shennitbaer sham. (Vegam en issur bemah shemmaakil lebehemat yisrael measabim shelliqqet bishbilo, sheap sheasur leyisrael lehanot mimmah sheasa hannokri bishbilo ap al pi shennitkavven letobat atzmo kemo shennitbaer sham, mikkol maqom kan en gupo mammash neheneh mizzeh — lo gazeru chakamim ella im ken hu atzmo omed bepaneha kede shettokal, abal lo al mah shehannokri maakilah, kevan shemmitkavven bazeh letobat atzmo). Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehannokri oseh ken derek miqreh (sheen haddabar yadua beberur shelliqqet gam bishbil yisrael, ki shemma liqqetan leatzmo veachar kak nimlak litten lebehemat yisrael). Abal im ragil laasot ken — tzarik limchot beyado (shekkevan shebbevadday hu liqqetan bishbilo — gazeru chakamim ap al mah shemmaakil hannokri mehem lebehemat yisrael):

Nokri sheasa beshabbat aron o qeber liqbor bo meto o limkor (beir sherubbah nokrim) — muttar leyisrael liqqaber bemotzae shabbat miyyad. Veim asao bishbil yisrael — tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, ben liqbor bo yisrael zeh shennaasa bishbilo, ben liqbor bo yisrael acher. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaqqeber o haaron omedim bemaqom hammutzna, sheen haddabar mepursam lakkol shennaasu beshabbat bishbil peloni yisrael. Abal qeber haomed beparhesya, veken aron hannaasa beshabbat etzel qeber haomed beparhesya, beinyan shehakkol yodeim sheqqeber zeh o aron zeh naasa beshabbat liploni yisrael — asur liqbor bo oto yisrael olamit, veap leachar bikde sheyyeasu, mishshum qenas al shennitchallel shabbat al yede nokri beparhesya bishbilo. Abal muttar liqbor bo yisrael acher leachar bikde sheyyeasu. Vehu haddin im nitchallel shabbat al yede nokri beparhesya bishbil yisrael chay — asur lo olamit, mishshum qenas, ap al pi shello tzivva et hannokri al kaka. Veyesh omerim shello aseru olamit gabbe met mishshum qenas ella mishshum sheggenay hu lemet sheyyiqqaber beqeber mepursam shennitchallel bo shabbat bishbilo. Ulepi zeh gabbe chay — muttar ap lo leachar bikde sheyyeasu. Uleet hatztzorek yesh lismok al datam lehaqel bedibre soperim. Veap lepi sebara harishona lo hechemiru chakamim ella kesheasa hannokri haddabar meatzmo, abal im qibbel alayv qodem hashshabbat laasot zeh veqatzatz lo hayyisrael sakar, velo qaba lo zeman ematay yaasennu, veasa beshabbat middaat atzmo — en issur min haddin leachar hamtana bikde sheyyeasu, ap al pi sheasa beparhesya. Vaapillu haya hannokri sekir yom, ella shello qaba lo hayyisrael ezeh yom, veasa meatzmo beshabbat. Vaapillu gabbe met muttar beinyan zeh min haddin, ella shennakon lehachamir ap gabbe chay ledibre hakkol, shello yehaneh mimmennu olamit shum adam miyyisrael, kol shennitchallel bo shabbat al yede nokri beparhesya al yede amirat yisrael, apillu asahu hannokri beqabbelanut, sheen bo issur meiqqar haddin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trs"d, ella im ken micha beyad hannokri velo hishgiach bo bishbil hanaat atzmo, kemo shennitbaer besiman rm"d:

Nokri shehebi beshabbat derek reshut harabbim chalilin lehaspid bahem yisrael, kevan shennaasa bahem issur shel tora, lo yaspidu bahem lo oto yisrael velo yisrael acher, ad sheyyamtinu bikde sheyyekolim lahabiam bemotzae shabbat meoto maqom shehebiam hannokri beshabbat, ben sheoto maqom hu chutz lattechum ben shehu betok hattechum. Veim eno yadua mehekan hebiam — day sheyyamtinu bikde sheyyekolin lahabiam michutz lattechum. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehebiam betzina, abal im hebiam beparhesya beinyan shehakkol yodeim shehubeu birshut harabbim beshabbat bishbil peloni yisrael — asur lehaspid bahem oto yisrael olamit. Vekol zeh birshut harabbim gemura, abal im hebiam derek karmelit, im hebiam mittok hattechum — en tzarik lehamtin kelal apillu lemi shehubeu bishbilo, shello hechemiru lemi shehuba bishbilo bekarmelit ella shello yehaneh mimmenna beshabbat atzmah, abal lo lehamtin bemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, ella im ken hebiam michutz lattechum sheaz moelet habaato beshabbat, mah sheen ken betok hattechum en habaato beshabbat moelet kol kak (mippene shehaya hayyisrael yakol lelek lesham beatzmo beshabbat velahabiam bemotzae shabbat miyyad, umishshum shiur muat shehaya shoheh bemotzae shabbat bachazirato mishsham lekan — en lachush bishbil kak shemma yomar lenokri lelek lesham beshabbat). Veim hu sapeq im hebiam michutz lattechum o mittok hattechum — asur lemi shehuba bishbilo, abal laacherim muttar, apillu bevadday chutz lattechum. Veim hebiam michutz lattechum derek karmelit, veachar kak heebiram derek reshut harabbim — en tzarik lehamtin ella bikde sheyyekolin lahabiam mittechillat reshut harabbim bemotzae shabbat, veachar kak muttar laacherim, o apillu lemi shehuba bishbilo im hubeu mittok hattechum:
